experiences.name: Phi Phi Islands Snorkeling & Island Hopping Tour
experiences.description: Embark on a full-day speedboat tour around the stunning Phi Phi archipelago, snorkeling in crystal-clear waters at Maya Bay, exploring Viking Cave, and swimming at Monkey Beach. One of Thailand's most iconic island-hopping experiences with breathtaking limestone karst scenery.

experiences.name: Bangkok Street Food Night Market Crawl
experiences.description: Dive into Bangkok's legendary street food scene at Yaowarat Road (Chinatown), sampling pad thai, mango sticky rice, grilled satay, boat noodles, and fresh seafood. Join a guided food walk or explore independently through the bustling night market stalls and open-air restaurants.

experiences.name: Koh Lanta Beach Hopping by Longtail Boat
experiences.description: Hire a traditional longtail boat to hop between Koh Lanta's most beautiful and secluded beaches including Bamboo Bay, Kantiang Bay, and Nui Beach. Enjoy snorkeling, sunbathing on pristine white sand, and experiencing the relaxed, less-commercialized side of Thai island life.

experiences.name: Chiang Mai Street Food & Night Bazaar Experience
experiences.description: Explore the famous Chiang Mai Night Bazaar and Sunday Walking Street, feasting on northern Thai specialties like khao soi (coconut curry noodles), sai oua (herbed sausage), and crispy pork rinds. Wander through hundreds of food stalls while soaking in the vibrant cultural atmosphere of the old city.
experiences.location: Wualai Walking Street, Old City, Chiang Mai

experiences.name: Similan Islands Liveaboard Snorkeling Trip
experiences.description: Join a two-day liveaboard or day-trip boat tour to the world-renowned Similan Islands National Park, considered one of the top snorkeling and diving destinations in Southeast Asia. Explore vibrant coral reefs, swim alongside sea turtles, and relax on pristine white-sand beaches with turquoise waters.
experiences.location: Similan Islands National Park, Phang Nga Province
